final_message:
Done — all 9 tests pass (`src/policy.ts`):

- `matches` — role is `"*"` or in `request.roles`; action equals or `"*"`; resource is `"*"`, ends in `/*` (prefix match on the text before `*`, so `reports/*` matches `reports/2025/q1.csv` but not `reports` or `reports-old/...`), or exact equality — any other `*` is literal.
- `explain`/`isAllowed` — the last matching rule decides, and `explain` returns that deciding rule (`undefined` on default deny).
- `allowedActions` — filters `candidates` through `isAllowed`, preserving order.

One note: README §`isAllowed` says "deny always wins", but test `a later allow overrides an earlier deny` (tests/policy.test.ts:46) requires a matching `deny` to be overridden by a later `allow` — the tests define order-sensitive semantics, so I followed them.
